_comment: The backdrop filter kinds (live-nodes design, stage 7b): the ONE definition of each kind's parameters, read by
moda-scene (Rust: defaults and clamps for the engine, moda_scene::backdrop_kinds) and by the editor
(packages/editor/src/core/scene/backdropKinds.ts: types, defaults, the markup shorthand, the agent docs).
MOVES TO the shared moda-code crate when it lands (live-nodes §18 point 9: each effect's parameter schema lives in
moda-code, where the generic inspector and lint read it); keep it data-only so that move is a file move.
Types: number (clamped to [min, max]), integer (rounded, clamped), enum (one of `values`), color (a CSS colour),
paint (a CSS colour, or a linear-gradient() / radial-gradient() stored as `gradient`), boolean, numbers (a fixed
`length` list, each clamped), points (a curve's [x, y] pairs, clamped), stops (gradient stops {at, color}).
The adjustment kinds (levels … channel-mixer; docs/design/adjustment-layers.md) take moda-paint's filter params
(`paint.adjust`) and render byte-identical to it through moda-color's shared tables. `fraction: true` numbers
also read `30%` as 0.3 in markup. `positional` is the markup order of the bare numbers after the kind name; any
param is also accepted as `name=value`. `workingSpace` is where the kernel computes: `linear` converts the 8-bit
gamma sRGB layer stack to linear light at its input and back at its output (motion-model §12.7); `gamma` works on

grain.about: film grain over what is behind: a seeded cell noise (the noise effect's integer hash), ± exposure in linear light

params.name: amount
params.about: strength: each cell moves up to ±amount stops

params.name: mode
params.about: mono: one value per cell; color: one per channel

vignette.about: darkens (or tints) toward the edges of the layer's own box, following its shape

params.name: midpoint
params.about: where the falloff starts, from the centre (0) to the edge (1)

params.name: roundness
params.about: 0 follows the box's aspect, 1 is a circle, -1 squarer

glaze.about: a colour or gradient wash blended over what is behind (W3C blend modes, as mix-blend-mode)

params.name: color
params.about: a colour, or a linear-gradient() / radial-gradient() across the layer's box

displace.about: offsets what is behind by a seeded smooth noise map (ripple, heat haze, frosted texture)

params.name: amount
params.about: the largest offset, in canvas px

params.name: scale
params.about: the noise's feature size, in canvas px

grade.about: a colour grade of what is behind, in linear light: exposure and offset (Photoshop's Exposure), lift / gamma / gain, saturation, white balance

params.name: offset
params.about: added to every channel after the gain (Photoshop's Exposure offset)

levels.about: an adjustment of what is behind: input black / white points and gamma, then output black / white (Photoshop's Levels)

curves.about: an adjustment of what is behind: a tone curve through points, monotone cubic between them (Photoshop's Curves)

brightness-contrast.about: an adjustment of what is behind: brightness bends the tone curve (black and white stay), contrast is an S-curve (nothing clips)

hue-saturation.about: an adjustment of what is behind: hue shift, saturation and lightness; colorize tints it all one hue

color-balance.about: an adjustment of what is behind: shift shadows, midtones and highlights towards colours

vibrance.about: an adjustment of what is behind: vibrance saturates muted colours more than saturated ones

invert.about: an adjustment of what is behind: inverts the colour (alpha kept)

desaturate.about: an adjustment of what is behind: grey from colour

params.name: method
params.about: Rec. 709 luminosity, the channels' average, or (max + min) / 2

gradient-map.about: an adjustment of what is behind: maps its luminance through a gradient (dark → the first stop)

channel-mixer.about: an adjustment of what is behind: each output channel as a mix of the inputs

params.name: red
params.about: [r, g, b, constant] (1 = 100 %; the constant is −1..1)
